# E2 and L7: advice never blocks, unless --strict asks for it.

# a package runner without a pinned version
exec metagente check unpinned.ag
stdout 'No problems found'
stderr 'Warning on line 3 of unpinned\.ag'
stderr 'does not pin a version of `weather-mcp`'
stderr 'weather-mcp@1\.2\.3'

! exec metagente check --strict unpinned.ag
stderr 'Found 1 problem\.'
! stdout .

# the same command with a version is quiet
exec metagente check pinned.ag
stdout 'No problems found'
! stderr .

# a think that can use every tool, including ones that change things
exec metagente check open_think.ag
stderr 'every tool the agent declared'
exec metagente check limited_think.ag
! stderr .

-- unpinned.ag --
agent A
  goal "x"
  tool weather from mcp "npx -y weather-mcp"
  accepts go
  on go
    reply "x"
-- pinned.ag --
agent A
  goal "x"
  tool weather from mcp "npx -y weather-mcp@1.2.3"
  accepts go
  on go
    reply "x"
-- open_think.ag --
agent A
  goal "x"
  tool file
  accepts go
  on go
    reply think "hi"
-- limited_think.ag --
agent A
  goal "x"
  tool file
  tool clock
  accepts go
  on go
    reply think "hi" using clock
